fieldValues.title: G4 Delegated practice
fieldValues.summary: A group can define roles, working groups and mandates, then connect decisions to the authority under which they were made.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need working groups or roles, and need to make their mandates and authority legible.

## Semantic Adds

- Role Record
- working-group Record
- mandate and authority relations

## Blueprint Adds

- role and mandate workspace
- authority context on decisions

## Does Not Introduce

- a founding constitution
- global identity or federation
- automatic enforcement of human authority

## Activation Trigger

A group delegates recurring work or needs to distinguish who may decide what.
